output.revised_prompt:
Edit Image 1 as the target, using Image 2 only as a layout-quality and construction reference. Create a complete commercial-grade production portrait slot cabinet master background for a game called COIN CARNIVAL, but bake in absolutely no words, letters, numbers, logos, icons, reel symbols, or watermarks anywhere. Preserve Image 1’s unique identity: true front elevation, tall narrow silhouette, extravagant celebratory ruby-red-and-gold body, two distinct tall exterior gold-coin waterfall towers, emerald cabochons, top coin-sunburst crown, front-facing symmetry, festive coin-shower energy. Do not copy Image 2’s exact cabinet shapes, dark styling, throne/vault imagery, or broad proportions.

Rebuild the central cabinet into a complete, physically plausible usable slot machine with integrated premium construction. At the top, create one large blank fan-shaped champagne-gold title plaque, clean and unobstructed. Directly below it, create a separate narrow dark ruby-glass counter socket intended for a GRAND display, completely blank. In the main center, create a clean warm-ivory reel glass with exactly 5 columns by 3 rows: champagne-gold grid lines, strong raised polished cast-metal vertical column dividers, subtle horizontal row dividers, bevelled display glass, all fifteen cells totally blank and empty. Beneath the reels, add a narrow black-and-gold inset result window intended for a COIN VAULT readout, but leave its entire face blank.

Below the result window, build a deep bowl-shaped brushed-gold control console integrated into the cabinet. Every control must be a real physical component seated in its own molded recessed well, aligned to the same frontal perspective and lighting, with clear spacing and no obstruction. Include: left Turbo rocker socket with blank rocker face; one large center amber-gold translucent Spin dome in a substantial cast-gold ring; right Auto lever/button socket with a compact premium lever or push control and blank face; a paired Bet minus/plus knob well containing two separate small matching brass knobs, both blank; and two separate low brass key/button sockets for Paytable and Rules, each distinct, small, blank, and accessible. No labels or markings on any face. Make the control deck deep enough to read clearly as a functional machine console, with brushed gold, edge rails, seams, fasteners, joints, and realistic mounting details.

Keep both coin-waterfall towers outside all functional openings: one left and one right, unmistakably separate, tall, filled with ridged gold coins pouring vertically into built-in bowls. Retain and refine the emerald gemstone medallions and red enamel side body. Do not let coins overlap the title plaque, counter socket, reel glass, result window, or controls. Make the cabinet visibly taller and narrower than the broad jade/retro reference, with a complete uncropped base and crown fully inside frame.

Materials and palette: layered champagne gold and yellow gold, polished cast-gold rails, brushed-gold control deck, realistic ridged coins, inset emerald-green glass, glossy ruby-red enamel, warm cream ivory reel field, dark ruby glass, small coral highlights, bevelled glass, screws, seams, joints, castings, and believable commercial-machine construction. Lighting should be abundant warm reflected gold, festive, soft, premium, celebratory, and high-roller—never black nightclub, heavy, solemn, gothic, or throne-like. Background may remain a soft deep ruby festive glow with subtle golden bokeh, while the full cabinet remains clearly separated and entirely visible.

Strict composition: portrait, true straight-on front elevation, centered, no perspective skew, complete usable machine, no people, no banknotes, no alcohol, no floating UI, no text of any kind, no numbers, no symbols inside reel cells, no watermark, no cropped cabinet.
